text: Never take the knight on g4 when the h-file opens against your castled king The Fishing Pole trap catches players who play h3 automatically in the Ruy Lopez or Italian. Black plays h5! After hxg4? hxg4, the open h-file and queen invasion on h4 force checkmate in 3. The defense: Ignore the g4 bait or challenge Black's center immediately with d4.
